answer: A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a swarm in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The yarrow cap is enforced at intake and terrace shows the per-origin counts. At most 5 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a wharf tag. That is 4 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
